tasks.title: Nmap PostgreSQL Scan
tasks.description: Fingerprint the version and check for weak/default authentication.

tasks.title: Try Default Credentials
tasks.description: postgres/postgres and postgres/<blank> are extremely common defaults, especially on lab/CTF-style boxes.

tasks.title: Connect & Enumerate
tasks.description: Once authenticated, list databases/users and confirm your privilege level.

tasks.title: RCE via COPY FROM PROGRAM
tasks.description: If your user has superuser rights (common misconfiguration), PostgreSQL >= 9.3 lets you execute arbitrary OS commands directly through SQL using COPY FROM PROGRAM.

tasks.title: Reverse Shell via COPY FROM PROGRAM
tasks.description: Chain the same technique into a full reverse shell back to your listener.
